peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES HOW THE PEG IS DEFENDED AND BY WHOM — NOT THE CURRENT DEVIATION, which is −1.35bp. Direct 1:1 USDC mint/redeem against M/T-bill backing. ⚠️ THE ARB PATH IS PERMISSIONED: only ONBOARDED holders can run it, so the mechanism that defends the peg is not available to the marginal secondary buyer. That is narrower than USDC's open path and more robust than a synthetic RWA wrapper — the score sits between them deliberately. ⚠️ A PLANNED STRC ROTATION IS FORWARD RISK CARRIED IN THIS SCORE and was still unrealized as of 2026-08-11; if it lands, this basis needs re-arguing, not re-dating.

backing.backing_score_basis: ⚠️⚠️ MEASURES HOW MUCH OF THE RESERVE CAN BE INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED — NOT WHETHER IT COVERS. THOSE DIVERGE COMPLETELY HERE, AND THE COVERAGE NUMBER IS PERFECT. PYUSDx held equals supply TO THE CENT; the feed reports collateral_ratio 100.0 with surplus_deficit −0.0 on $67,164,376.55. ⚠️ THAT IS A VERIFIABILITY COLLAPSE, NOT A SOLVENCY ONE, AND A READER SEEING 100.0 WILL CONCLUDE THE OPPOSITE OF THE FINDING. The 2026-08-19 upgrade rotated the reserve to PYUSDx, which VOIDED THE TWO THINGS THE PRIOR 6.5 WAS EXPLICITLY EARNED ON — 'every dollar matched by tokens you can verify with three on-chain calls' and 'all capital sits directly in the USDat smart contract address'. PYUSDx holds NOTHING at its own address: it is an issuer-minted M0-style earner extension whose reserves sit at a PORTAL LAYER THAT HAS NOT BEEN WALKED. So the chain of verification terminates one layer short of the assets. ⚠️ 6.5 -> 4.5 -> 5.5, BOTH MOVES ON 2026-08-23 — the intermediate 4.5 over-corrected. ⚠️ AND THIS ROW STATED THE 2026-08-11 POSITION WHILE ITS OWN FRONTMATTER HAD MOVED TWICE, i.e. it was TWO PASSES BEHIND ITSELF until 2026-09-08.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — reserve structure and verifiability, not a spot ratio
backing.backing_score_denominator: ⚠️ collateral_ratio 100.0 IS AN IDENTITY, NOT EVIDENCE. Backing is defined as PYUSDx held, and PYUSDx held is minted against supply, so the ratio cannot print anything else. It says the two sides of one issuer's ledger agree. It says NOTHING about whether the portal-layer reserves exist. Never quote '100% collateralized' for this asset without the portal caveat attached.

The prior 7.5 was A MODEL ARTIFACT. Observed depth is FLAT against 2026-06-04 ($500,000) and the peg band IMPROVED (10.51 -> 6.44bps). Three PegTracker fixes did it: 903a747 slippage-vs-venue-spot, 8eaeb4d truncated-ladder guard, 7040947 $5M exit ladder. ⚠️ A SCORE CUT ON A MARKET THAT IMPROVED WILL READ AS DETERIORATION TO ANYONE WHO DOES NOT HAVE THIS SENTENCE.
